name: Eric Ramos Law, PLLC
about: Eric Ramos Law, PLLC is a personal injury firm with a single office in San Antonio.
The firm states that it works on a contingency fee, with nothing to pay unless the case is won; the first consultation is free. It publishes material in English and Spanish.

google.source: Google Business Profile via Places API. 1 listing, counts summed and rating weighted by count

completeness.note: Categories, opening hours and photo count come from the Places API. The owner's own description, the services list, the Q&A and recent posts are owner-side fields the API does not expose at any price, so they are not scored either way. The API does expose Google's editorial summary, which is a different thing: Google writes those about notable places and has written one for no firm in this directory.

ahrefs.source: Ahrefs Site Explorer, batch endpoint, subdomains mode, organic figures for the United States

json_ld_descriptions: Eric Ramos Law, PLLC is a San Antonio-based personal injury law firm representing injured Texans in car accidents, truck accidents, motorcycle accidents, wrongful death, medical malpractice, and a wide range of other personal injury and accident cases. The firm operates on a contingency-fee basis — no fee unless we win.

Eric Ramos Law, PLLC is a personal injury law firm serving San Antonio and all of Texas. We represent injured victims in car accidents, truck accidents, motorcycle accidents, slip and fall, wrongful death, medical malpractice, and more. No fee unless we win.

Eric Ramos is a San Antonio-based personal injury attorney and founder of Eric Ramos Law, PLLC. He has represented hundreds of injured Texans in car accident, truck accident, wrongful death, and personal injury cases, fighting to maximize compensation while the insurance companies try to minimize it.

score.verdict: 1 eligibility gate(s) still to be checked. 2 could not be answered from the available records (G1, G2) and do not count against the firm. Certification needs more of the scale measured than we have managed here, pillar A in particular. Strongest pillar: C; most headroom in pillar A (0/25).
